Ava: Quick question — for the "break-glass" fallback chooser in the console, are we comfortable with a GLOBAL emergency switch that ops can flip, or should the chooser be per-service / per-route?

Priya: Per-route. Global is too blunt. We should support inheritance (org -> service -> route) so teams can opt-in.

Miguel: Per-route + a global template apply makes sense. Global could be a shorthand that seeds per-route decisions.

Rowan: UI thought: a small red "Breakglass" pill next to rollout controls. Click = confirm modal with required reason + TTL. Also show compact diff preview in the modal.

Dan: Audit requirements: capture operator id, original policy snapshot, diff, reason, TTL, and a unique activation id. Auto-revert after TTL is critical.

Priya: Agree on TTL. Also suggest rate-limits: at most 3 activations per org per hour by default.

Jess: For Private deployments we need an approval flow (two-person auth) depending on org tier. Also encryption of audit logs (KMS).

Ava: UX: can the modal show the before/after policy diff inline? Designers want compact side-by-side.

Rowan: I can mock a compact inline diff + a "preview impact" CTA. The preview could show affected routes and estimated qps change.

sally-bot: [system] Rollout change recorded: id=rb-2026-04-12-01 by @Dan

Miguel: Impl note — backend will expose POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/breakglass with body like the snippet below. We'll accept aliases (emergency_override) but keep "breakglass" in the UI copy for clarity:

```
{
  "actor": "dan",
  "reason": "prod p95 latency spike",
  "ttl_seconds": 3600,
  "apply_to": ["route:autocomplete", "route:search"]
}
```

Priya: Can we standardize the API name to emergency_override while keeping the UI label "Breakglass"? Less scary in telemetry metrics.

Dan: Fine to alias in API. UI should be explicit though.

Jess: Audit storage policy: store full policy snapshot + diff + metrics at activation time. Retention 13 months for legal. Also immutable audit records.

Ava: Telemetry: emit a "breakglass_activation" event with fields: actor, scope, reason tag, pre_latency (if available), post_latency (if available), and activation_id. That will let us build a "why did we switch" card.

Rowan: UI banner idea: route page shows "Breakglass active — expires in 51m" with revert and details link. Also a small history pill showing recent activations.

Priya: Safety checks server-side: reject activations that would lower model security below org_min_model_tier. Enforce via policy engine.

Miguel: Edge-case: if operator loses network during confirm, we need idempotent activation. Use optimistic locking via config_version and return a canonical activation id.

Dan: Also add a short-lived operator session token for this action so we can revoke if needed.

Ava: Design question: should we allow partial apply (only scale down quantization for latency) vs full model swap? The modal should show what will change at parameter level.

Rowan: I'll include a collapsed param list (model variant, quantization, batching) in the mock.

Jess: Also prevent emergency override from being used to route PII workloads to unvetted regions. Server-side checks again.

Priya: Implementation plan: spec API + server checks; annotate allowed transitions; TTL logic and auto-revert worker.

Miguel: PR note: add endpoint + controller + activation store; activation records include pre_snapshot, post_snapshot, activation_id, actor, ttl, reason.

sally-bot: [deploy-bot] CI started for PR #4523 (breakglass-api)

Dan: Playbook: when activated, oncall gets a short alert with link to revert and to postreason. Also include a checklist: verify degraded quality, monitor latency, plan revert.

Ava: Next actions: 
- Rowan: two mocks (per-route modal + global seed) by Tue EOD
- Priya + Miguel: API + server-side checks spec in proto repo by EOW
- Dan + Jess: audit/revert playbook + retention policy doc by next Wed

Rowan: Noted. Will upload Figma links here when ready.

Priya: Will add emergency_override / breakglass RPC to proto and paste link here.

Miguel: I'll start a WIP branch for the activation store and TTL worker.

Ava: Thanks all. @Priya ping when the proto is up; @Rowan ping when mocks are in. We'll reconvene if there are blockers.

Priya: Proto added: https://git.redwood/proto/rollouts#L233 (WIP)

Miguel: WIP PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4523 (server checks coming)

sally-bot: [system] Thread archived due to inactivity.
